_comment: AHSync's curated cooldown catalog (SPEC §3.4F.1), version 1, 2026-11-20. It holds every Classic Era (1.12) profession action that creates an item and has a cooldown: the 13 recipes with a cooldown, found by checking the tooltip of every item-creating recipe of the 12 professions on Wowhead Classic (1,379 spells), plus the tool uses whose Use spell creates an item on a cooldown (Salt Shaker, SnowMaster 9000). Generated into the addon as addon/AHProfit/Data/Cooldowns.lua by tools/gen_cooldown_data.py; never edit that file by hand. Field rules: key = the Classic item id, which is AHF's key for an unsuffixed item. cooldown_s converts the tooltip text ('2 days'), except the Salt Shaker's, which is exact from its item data. group 'transmute' is the shared transmute cooldown; no source states it outright, and Wowhead comments and the wiki imply it, so it is checked in game (SPEC §6 item 7). tool = an item the character must hold in its bags or bank; tool_use = the row is the tool's Use spell, so it has no recipe to learn. FOREVER CAVEAT: WoW: Forever customises items and professions, so this list may be incomplete or wrong for its content; correct it as differences are found and ship the fix with the addon (SPEC §3.4F.1, §6).

recipes.name: Transmute: Arcanite
recipes.note: Needs a Philosopher's Stone. 48 h in 1.x; Era data shows 2 days.

recipes.name: Mooncloth
recipes.note: Made at a moonwell. Wowhead shows 4 days; the wiki says 92 h before 2.4.3.

recipes.name: Salt Shaker
recipes.note: The Salt Shaker's Use spell; the tool is made by Engineering 250. The cooldown is exact from the item data.

recipes.name: SnowMaster 9000
recipes.note: The SnowMaster 9000's Use spell; likely a Winter Veil item.

recipes.name: Transmute: Elemental Fire
recipes.note: Needs a Philosopher's Stone. Its own 10-minute cooldown, not the shared transmute one (a 2006 comment says patch 1.10 briefly shared it).
